hints.title: Value and Index Ordering
hints.text: Tie-breaking by index means sorting the pairs (nums[i], i) naturally resolves which element to select first.

hints.title: Marking Adjacent Locations
hints.text: Maintain a boolean array indicating which indices have already been marked.

hints.title: Simultaneous Neighborhood Invalidation
hints.text: When picking an unmarked element at index i, add its value to score and mark indices i - 1, i, and i + 1.

hints.title: Sorted Element Marking Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting element-index pairs takes O(n log n); linear pass takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly scanning the array for the minimum unmarked element takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for sorted pairs and boolean marked array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts indexed elements and uses a boolean marker array.
